title: Meta expands CoreWeave deal with another $21B commitment

summary: Meta is not waiting for its own data centers to catch up with its AI ambitions. It is renting the capacity it needs right now.
summary_zh: Meta 并不等待自己的数据中心赶上其人工智能雄心。它正在租用目前所需的容量。
